about_the_game:
Welcome to Tiny Harvest, a small and relaxing desktop game that lives quietly on your screen while you work, study, or browse the internet.

  • HOW DOES IT WORK?

In the corner of your desktop, a tiny space farmer responds to every click and keystroke you make throughout the day. You don’t need to pay attention, he takes care of planting and harvesting on his own. As you harvest space plants, you'll earns credits you can then use, along with your inputs, to upgrade his tools, crops, home, and spaceship.

  • PERSONALIZATION

Want to personalize your farmer? Unlock a variety of charming hats as you go and choose between two different characters. They won’t boost performance, but they’ll definitely boost style.

  • LIGHTWIGHT AND COZY

Tiny Harvest is an idle game with no intrusive menus, no pop-ups, and no stress. Lightweight, cozy, always present—like a virtual houseplant that thrives quietly while you go about your day.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Any Windows that boots up.
  • Processor: If it can run Notepad, it can run this.
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Anything that shows pixels.
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
  • Sound Card: If your PC beeps when it starts, that counts.
  • Additional Notes: Also runs in lucid dreams.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Any Windows that boots up without asking too many questions.
  • Processor: Something that doesn't sound like a blender when you open a browser.
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: A GTX 1050 or a brave little chip that believes in itself.
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
  • Sound Card: If your speakers make happy little sounds, you're all set.
  • Additional Notes: Doesn’t mind being ignored. In fact, it prefers it.

short_description: Tiny Harvest is a relaxing desktop game that runs while you work, study, or browse the internet. Grow space plants, upgrade your crops, ship, home, and tools, and enjoy a cozy, minimalist experience designed to keep you company throughout your day.
